text:
alex kim: Quick check — who is on the 23:00 UTC deploy? Need smoke owners, rollback lead, and DB read-only prep. ETA ~45m.

maria ramos: I'll take smoke for the API layer. Will run the endpoint sanity script and load-check the /health and /predict routes. :white_check_mark:

samir patel: I'll be the rollback lead. If we need to revert, I can run the rollback sequence and coordinate the config switch.

jin park: I'll handle infra scaling and watch GPU pool. If we see elevated OOM or queuing, I'll trigger the throttles.

alex kim: thanks. maria — can you verify the smoke script covers embeddings and streaming? small snippet below: 
```bash
# smoke.sh
curl -s -X POST $URL/generate -d '{"prompt":"test","max_tokens":8}' | jq .
curl -s $URL/embeddings -d '{"input":"test"}' | jq .
```

maria ramos: yep covered. also will run a quick multi-tenant test against a staging dataset.

nora liu: I'm on DB prep. I'll put the read-only flag for analytics and make sure replica lag < 5s. Will post when done.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window: 2026-03-17T23:00:00Z -> 2026-03-17T23:30:00Z. Canary traffic: 10% for first 5m, then 50% for 10m, then ramp.

alex kim: Rollback criteria (confirming): - error rate > 2% sustained for 3m OR 500ms p95 increase vs baseline OR failed schema migration. Samir, you good to execute on that?

samir patel: Good with that. My checklist: 
- run `tools/rollbacks/restore-config.sh v2026-03-17`
- scale down canaries `kubectl scale --replicas=0 deploy/canary`
- point traffic back to stable ingress rule
I'll also tag the release in case we need audit.

alex kim: Perfect. One more: owners for customer-facing comms if we need to alert customers?

nora liu: I'll draft a short status and hand to product for posting if we have a rollback.

maria ramos: Posting quick smoke results here in 10m before the window.

alex kim: Great — last call: any outstanding blockers?

jin park: GPU images are building, but one quantized variant failed a unit test. Not blocking the deploy (we're using non-quantized), but FYI.

alex kim: Noted. If that test regresses in canary, we'll abort and Samir will run rollback.

maria ramos: smoke run complete — all checks passed, /predict latency nominal.

alex kim: thanks everyone. I'll post a final "deploy go" here at T-5. :rocket:
